source_value.trigger: A keyboard sequence over the running lazygit surface, readable from the footer's key echo: space to stage the selected file, 'c' to open the commit editor, <tab> to move from summary to description, Enter to commit, then 'P' to push.
source_value.start_state: At 0.5s the Files panel is focused with '?? my-file.txt' selected and its diff shown in the 'Unstaged changes' pane; Commits reads '1 of 30' and Status has no ahead marker.
source_value.end_state: At 11s the file is committed and pushed: Commits reads '1 of 31' with '0853c88f my commit summary' on top, Status shows the clean check mark again, the Command log's last line is 'bed3ebc..0853c88  feature/demo -> feature/demo', and by 12s the surface has been quit and the terminal is empty.
source_value.continuity: Panels never move or resize; each step repaints in place. Staging flips the file's marker from '??' to 'A' and retitles the right pane 'Unstaged changes' -> 'Staged changes' while its diff text stays identical, and the commit editor opens as two bordered boxes over the middle of the layout without disturbing the panels around it.
source_value.feedback: Blue selection bar, yellow-green active border on the focused panel and on the commit editor, the footer's action name plus echoed key, the '↑1' ahead marker in Status and beside the branch, the 'Pushing... -' / 'Pushing... /' spinner panel, and the Command log line appended per git command.
source_value.reduced_motion_equivalent: The only animation in the recording is the one-character push spinner; every other change is an instant text repaint that persists, and the push is also reported non-animatedly by the '↑1' marker and the Command log line. No reduced-motion preference is shown in the product.
